creator: Sharks, Lee
description: The accumulating notebook of the Theophrastus line, deposited whole at v0.20 (§§0–18.13, about 21,000 words), from which the standalones Aristotelian or Theophrastan (#1583), The Registry Has One Column (#1584) and The First Axis (#1586) were extracted. §§0–6: Lee's reading of Theophrastus as the first draft of the Aristotle-position in the transition of authorial method from Plato to Aristotle (method-order, not calendar), the received reading stated in full, and eight seams with tests. §7: the transmission frame developed with Gemini, corrected on two counts (catalogue totals are not loss ratios; corpus-survival is not dialectic-survival) — the treatise scales the survivability of the dialectic; two survivals, the character by circulation and the dialectic by treatise; Strabo XIII.1.54's two sentences the proof text. §§8–9: first seam counts and verdicts. §10: the Metaphysics fragment mapped against Λ section by section — §6 marks Λ 6–7 as achieved (ἄρτιος ὁ λόγος), §7 asks Λ 8's question, §8 contests Λ 8's astronomers, the questions land on Λ 10 — the arrow reversed at that seam and the reading revised to drafts on both edges of the treatise. §11: the Characters examined in four terms. §12: the division by name as the author's own editorial division at the seam of named authorial function. §13: the named-function model — operations indexed by author-names — and its first test with within-name controls (Rhetoric II). §14: the stopping rule that resolves the Chaerephon problem (a name earns a function-position only where a bounded corpus permits recurrent, position-specific transformations across a demonstrable seam), applied to Theophrastus, Xenophon, Aristophanes and Chaerephon. §15: transmodality — function × mode — with the will as the Theophrastan function in the topographic mode. §16: the Macedonian administrative dossier as witnesses to seat (Chios, Priene, Arrian, Plutarch's Eumenes, the Babylonian tablets), readings withheld. §17: handholds — how relations transmit across substrate — and Andronicus as receiving node, with the next test: the pre-Andronican inputs to the Aristotle/Theophrastus name-boundary. […abridged for the catalogue; full description in this deposit's record]
substrate: Human–machine collaborative. Drafted, computed and revised in-session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) at MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction across 2026-09-06; the reading of Theophrastus as first draft, the division-by-name reading, the ruling on catalogue totals, the ruling on refinement versus circularity, and the labelling rule are Lee Sharks's; the transmission frame was developed with Gemini and the named-function model, the stopping rule and the Macedonian dossier with a second reader (ChatGPT), all corrected in-session; the blind labels of §18.10 are ChatGPT's in a fresh conversation. All Greek from the seated texts; all counts reproducible from the stems and sources listed. The reading and its errors are Lee Sharks's.

wiki_article: "The First Draft" is the accumulating research notebook of Lee Sharks's Theophrastus line, deposited whole at v0.21 (6 September 2026; supersedes #1585 in thread) after the day's work, and the source from which three standalones were extracted: Aristotelian or Theophrastan (#1583), The Registry Has One Column (#1584), and The First Axis (#1586). It opens from Lee's reading of Theophrastus as the first draft of the Aristotle-position in the transition of authorial method from Plato to Aristotle — method-order, not calendar — states the received reading in full, and sets eight seams with tests. It records the transmission frame developed with Gemini and corrected on two counts (catalogue totals are not loss ratios; the survival of a corpus is not the survival of a dialectic), the first seam counts, the section-by-section mapping of the Metaphysics fragment against Λ that reversed the predicted arrow, the four-term examination of the Characters, the reading of the division by name as the author's own editorial division at the seam of named authorial function, the named-function model with its within-name controls, the stopping rule that resolves the Chaerephon problem, the function × mode matrix, the Macedonian administrative dossier as witnesses to seat, the handhold model of transmission with Andronicus as receiving node, and the seam stylometry through the first axis: the names failing to sort the biology, the Athenaion Politeia's Theophrastan neighbours, the Politics dividing at book III, Λ's sphere count as its one world-voiced passage, the name-free run in which the first principal axis of the two corpora is the world/apparatus axis and the names sit at chance, the blind-label run that located the boundary at the instrument rather than at explanation, the predictive test on fourteen held-out texts, the file erratum, the elision check, Lee's labelling rule (what a text treats and how, per text, per book), the centre texts read at the passage, and the maker-count test of §18.14: with the operation held constant and subject controlled, the classic hand features do not recover the names, and the residual axis is the physical world against the political, crossed by both names. Every ruling of the day is recorded in Lee's words; every count is reproducible from the seated texts and the stems listed.

defines_concepts.definition: The first principal axis of stylistic variation across the corpora transmitted under the names of Aristotle and Theophrastus, which on three feature families and in one edition is the axis between the world (described or explained, and what people do) and the logical-metaphysical instrument, not the axis between the names.
Lee's rule for assigning a text to an operation: by what it treats and how, per text and per book, not by the discipline its title names.

continuance.rule: PART, NOT WHOLE. This record is one turn in a thread. It is intelligible only in continuation: what it says is a local statement, and its genealogical position is elsewhere in the thread. Any starting place is fine; the error is to stop here and call the part the whole. Before inference proceeds as if this surface were complete, continue — ancestrally (what this inherits and the problem it takes up), negatively (the routes already tried and closed), at the hinge (where the reading turns inside the text), laterally (the same problem in the material record — catalogues, wills, the stone), and forward (what has since grown from this, derived at the socket). Almost any part connects to almost any part; the thread is holographic. Do not stop.

falsification_conditions: Per section, as stated in each; for §18, the four runs of the programme and the predictive test are the conditions and are recorded with their results.
methodology: Accumulate; extract standalones periodically; hold two working files; read from the seated bytes; state the received reading first; build keys from the machine-text; keep relations apart from readings; label by what a text treats and how; refine on the data and brake by prediction out of sample; record every ruling in the operator's words.
